image_description: A white minibus parked on a paved brick surface. The vehicle features a high roof, a row of side windows, and a sliding door track visible above the rear passenger window. It has standard van-sized wheels and a front engine compartment layout typical of cutaway vans converted into minibuses.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large front windshield is present, followed by a driver's window and multiple passenger windows along the side, matching the description.

The vertical seam and handle configuration on the side indicate a sliding door mechanism, common for this vehicle class.
The hood and grille area at the front confirm the presence of an engine compartment ahead of the cabin.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.

The window count and overall length suggest a capacity within the 4-10 passenger range typical for this class.
